number_of_accused.quote: conviction of 17 accused out of which six accused persons
number_of_accused.reason: Seventeen accused were convicted at trial, and the Supreme Court decided their appeals.

accused_gender.reason: All named accused are male; the judgment uses male patronymics and 'his son' references.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or tribe of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of the accused is not stated; the Sarpanch is a deceased co-accused, not occupation of accused.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth or class statement about the accused appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: Purshottam, Ram Kumar Dhaka, Kalu Lal Mali and Lakendra Sharma
victim_gender.reason: All five deceased are named male victims.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victims is named as such.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victims is described.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the father nurtured deep rooted suspicion that the deceased persons had not only masterminded a well thought out plan
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Prior enmity from suspected involvement in the Sarpanch's son's murder is accurately described.

statutory_provisions.quote: charges under Sections 147, 427, 435, 148, 302, 460 and 342 IPC and in respect of 435/149 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections listed match the charges and convictions in the judgment.

weapon.quote: armed with Gandasis, Swords, Sabals and sticks
weapon.reason: Weapons match, but the 'axe-like' description is not in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: got the autopsy done in respect of !he dead bodies, seized the blood stained clothes, recorded the statements of the witnesses
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery, site plan and autopsy evidence are all described.

confession.correct_value: None; weapons were recovered on information furnished by accused in custody, but the judgment does not say the court treated it as a non-confession
confession.quote: on the basis of the information furnished by the accused persons, while they were in custody, recovered the weapons
confession.reason: The recovery is described, but the claim that the court rejected it as a confession is not stated.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the whole crime was committed in a planned design
aggravating_circumstances.reason: High Court finding of planned design and the ghastly assault are both supported.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: specific overt acts have not been attributed and similarly placed accused persons have been given life sentence
mitigating_circumstances.reason: High Court mitigating reasons, custody period and similarly placed accused are all supported.

trial_court_outcome.quote: six accused persons ... were imposed death sentence and the rest 11 accused ... were sentenced with rigorous imprisonment of life
trial_court_outcome.reason: Death sentences for six and life for eleven, with the rest acquitted, match the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: the conviction and sentence imposed by the trial court was maintained
high_court_outcome.reason: Partial allowance, commutations, acquittals and maintained convictions for four accused match.

final_outcome.quote: the appeal filed by the accused-appellants ... are dismissed
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, so the convictions of the four accused stand.

offence_finally_established.quote: the conviction under Section 302 could not be interfered with
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder conviction under s.302 (with s.149 for the group) is upheld for those whose convictions stand.

imprisonment_type.quote: no error in the decision of the High Court by which it commuted the death sentence to life imprisonment
imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence for the upheld accused is life imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life imprisonment is not a fixed term, so null is correct.

fine_rs.reason: No final fine is stated at the Supreme Court level.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The first group comprised about 24 named men plus 15-20 others, roughly 40 persons in total.
neutral_facts.quote: Ram Narayan, Mohan Lal, Yuvraj, Hansraj ... along with 15-20 others came being armed
neutral_facts.reason: Crowd size '25 to 30' understates the named accused plus 15-20 others; otherwise facts track the judgment without outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment for s.302.

attempt_completion.quote: the real crime, the assault and the murder took place after midnight

physical_harm.quote: assaulted them with Gandasis and swords on their heads, faces, hands and feet
physical_harm.reason: Five deaths and the blows to head, face, hands and feet are described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 7 charged; 5 finally upheld for the four accused whose convictions were maintained (ss.148, 427, 342, 460, 302)
number_of_offences.quote: the High Court ... Hence the present cross-appeals ... conviction and sentence imposed by the trial court was maintained
number_of_offences.reason: Seven sections charged is correct, but the upheld count is not given; the judgment maintains multiple convictions per accused.

financial_property_loss.quote: They took both the motorcycles in the passage and burnt the same
financial_property_loss.reason: Two motorcycles taken and burnt; value not stated, which is accurate.

premeditation_planning.quote: the whole crime was committed in a planned design
premeditation_planning.reason: High Court's planned-design finding is accurately recorded, with the revenge motive.

motive.quote: the crime had taken place because Ram Narayan had suspected that the deceased persons were responsible for extinguishing the life spark of his son
motive.reason: Court accepted revenge motive from suspected killing of the Sarpanch's son.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: their testimony have withstood the rigorous cross-examination in material particulars and received corroboration from the evidence of the doctor
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness testimony, medical corroboration, seized weapons and FIR delay explanation are all supported.

witness_credibility.quote: We find that their evidence is reliable and credible
witness_credibility.reason: Relatives were scrutinised with care and found reliable, with minor discrepancies.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: After the killings, the accused burnt the two motorcycles and left the scene.
post_offence_conduct.quote: They took both the motorcycles in the passage and burnt the same and, after the inhumane and barbaric act, left the scene.
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment describes post-offence conduct (burning motorcycles, leaving the scene), so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.quote: all the accused persons have almost spent thirteen years in custody
custody_duration.reason: The Court states almost thirteen years in custody.

bail_history.reason: No bail history is mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.quote: in the intervening night of 28th and 29th June, 2001
trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Sushil Kumar Jain, Puneet Jain, Anurag Gohil, Pratibha Jain for the Appellants. Imtiaz Ahmed, Naghma Imtiaz, Milind Kumar for the Respondent
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for accused and State match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: submitted the charge-sheets on different dates before the Judicial Magistrate, Digod
investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation steps, charge-sheet, committal and completed trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment notes no procedural irregularity.

appeal_history.reason: Trial outcome, High Court partial allowance and Supreme Court dismissal are accurately summarised.

prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment records no State submissions, so 'Not stated' is accurate.

defence_argument.quote: innocent persons were dragged into trial and suffered immensely
defence_argument.reason: Delay, interested witnesses, no independent witness, unspecified roles and innocent implication are all raised.

legal_principle_applied.quote: mere delay in lodging the First Information Report cannot be regarded by itself as fatal
legal_principle_applied.reason: Delay, related-witness scrutiny, acquittal interference and rarest of rare principles are applied.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: State of H.P. v. Gian Chand1, ... (2001) 6 sec 11
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Main precedents and citations match the judgment's footnotes.

sentencing_rationale.quote: it is not a case which can be treated to be a case of extreme culpability
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale for life imprisonment over death is accurately summarised.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: similarly placed persons have been imposed life sentence. Quite apart from that, all the accused persons have almost spent thirteen years in custody
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court weighed similarly placed accused and custody; overt-acts and Ram Narayan points come from High Court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The Supreme Court did not expressly weigh aggravating factors, so 'None' is accurate.

other_sentence_order.reason: No compensation, directions or guidelines are ordered.
